rules.implementation: budgets with lanes per row; detail never omits; steps never summarized; neutral lens only
computed from declared cells/transitions only; hatches are explicit lines; never replaces the P1 report
closed style set; post-processing of an unchanged VP-06 result; arrowhead and colours untouched
hard limits; every row/object referenced; facet targets declared
fixed concept table; labels verbatim or declared label map; tracks and witness prefixes only from declared files; no P1 validation
deterministic packing in declared order; (cell, step) coverage proven per run and by check-panels; text-only index
epistemic_warrant, current_authority, canonical_admission stay NOT_EVALUATED; source_status declared_unverified
VP-01…VP-06 byte-identical; vpprint unchanged; VP-06 examples re-render identically
0.7.0 documents keep the 0.7.0 code path; 14 pinned 0.7.0 output digests reproduced byte for byte; from-plan emits 0.7.1 unless --profile 0.7.0
outer,inner with distinct keys; outer groups in declared order, inner packing as PE-2; outer_ledger per outer value recomputed by check-panels; index grouped by outer value
codes T1…Tn (source order, stable across panels and slices); 11 px code text; up to 4 per boundary at 16 px pitch; transition legend below the grid, wrapped, full text in <title>
Hatch A / Hatch B wording; swatch and text separate elements
computed from declared cells, transitions and target_step, or transcribed declared_end (slice-safe); end cap without colour; VP07_DECLARED_GAP warning; never replaces the P1.10.1 report

declared layer map only (never derived); rows and flow nodes ordered by (layer, declared position); cell order within a row unchanged; layer bands without fill; flow caption; partition layer never merges layers; 0.7.0/0.7.1 outputs byte-identical (30 pinned scenarios)

binding-context/7 selects 0.7.3; P1.11 bindings transcribed with declaration_ref onto shown transitions and bars (refs outside the slice kept and marked hidden); methods in the transition legend in catalog order and as a bar suffix that is never cut; markers unchanged apart from metadata; no colour, hatch or glyph for methods; catalog constant shared with VP-09; 0.7.0/0.7.1/0.7.2 outputs byte-identical (43 pinned scenarios)

key = the bar's own declared method, else the reserved group none; groups in catalog order, local methods, none last; groups never merged, large groups split by subject; single and nested; works on 0.7.3 and 0.7.4 sources; subtitles short name, ledger full ID
